rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for making something stronger or reinforcing it, including an army or other organization.

example.english: We need to strengthen security so no one can take advantage.
example.traditional: 我哋要加強保安，唔好畀人有機可乘。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gaa1 koeng4 bou2 on1 m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 jau5 gei1 ho2 sing4

rows.note: Use this when strengthening someone means encouraging or giving them moral courage.

example.english: My teacher often encourages me, helping strengthen my confidence to keep going.
example.traditional: 老師成日鼓勵我，幫我增強繼續落去嘅信心。
example.jyutping: lou5 si1 seng4 jat6 gu2 lai6 ngo5 bong1 ngo5 zang1 koeng4 gai3 zuk6 lok6 heoi3 ge3 seon3 sam1

rows.note: Use this for the support side of the sense, especially supporting a person, group, plan, or cause.

example.english: Thanks for supporting my decision; it helps strengthen my resolve.
example.traditional: 多謝你一直支持我個決定，令我更有勇氣。
example.jyutping: do1 ze6 nei5 jat1 zik6 zi1 ci4 ngo5 go3 kyut3 ding6 ling6 ngo5 gang3 jau5 jung5 hei3

rows.note: Use this when the subject itself grows or becomes stronger rather than being strengthened by someone else.

example.english: If you practise every day, you will gradually strengthen.
example.traditional: 只要每日操練，你就會慢慢變強。
example.jyutping: zi2 jiu3 mui5 jat6 cou1 lin6 nei5 zau6 wui5 maan6 maan6 bin3 koeng4
